_1_kya_hai: X (Twitter) se handle ki PHOTO, COVER aur BIO laane ke liye aapke apne X login ke tokens. Ye sirf aap bhar sakte ho -- kisi aur ko mat dena.
_2_kahan_se_milega: Chrome me x.com par login karo -> F12 (DevTools) -> Application tab -> Storage -> Cookies -> https://x.com . Wahan teen cookie dikhengi: auth_token, ct0, twid. Teeno ki VALUE copy karke neeche paste kar do.
_3_kya_karna_hai: Is file ka naam badal kar x_config.json kar do, phir neeche teeno value bhar do. Uske baad chalao: python fetch_x_profiles.py
_4_SECRET: Isme aapke X account ka access hai. Ye file kisi ko mat bhejna, folder share karte waqt hata dena, aur mongo_dump / USB me na jaaye.
_5_agar_na_bharo: Koi dikkat nahi -- Handle Analytics tab tab bhi poora chalega, bas photo ki jagah naam ke initials dikhenge.
